newsitem.title: POLAND: Optimus eyes March 19 for new share trade.
newsitem.headline: Optimus eyes March 19 for new share trade.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA wants its 1.104,573 new shares, which were issued for converting 159 convertible bonds, to start bourse trade on March 19, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
Optimus received the orders to convert the 159 of its 300 five-year convertible bonds into shares last month.

Last week Optimus said it had received orders to convert into shares another 20 of the bonds and as a result its share capital would increase by 138,940 shares. The conversion of all the bonds would bring the firm's number of shares outstanding to 6,484,108. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
